prompt: Create a realistic vertical concert photo of a Japanese underground idol who looks like an office worker performing on a small dark live-house stage. The singer is a young adult Japanese woman leaning forward toward the audience, smiling warmly while singing into a black handheld microphone held in her right hand, with her left hand pressed over her chest. She has dark brown hair tied back with loose bangs and face-framing strands, natural idol makeup, and an expressive approachable face. Outfit: a fitted black business blazer, open-collar white dress shirt with a slightly glamorous stage look, tight black mini skirt, sheer black pantyhose, black high heels, and a blue lanyard with a visible corporate-style ID badge hanging at her waist. The scene is shot from a low audience perspective, full body visible, with shallow depth of field; include exactly two foreground audience elements: one blurred pair of raised clapping hands with a yellow wristband at lower left, and one blurred back-of-head silhouette at lower right. Background: black curtains, exposed ceiling pipes and rigging, small venue speakers, and colored stage lights, including one red light on the left, one blue light near center-right, and one bright warm white light on the right. Lighting should feel like a candid live performance: dramatic club stage illumination, glossy highlights on hair and clothing, realistic skin tones, slight motion energy but sharp focus on the singer. Composition: vertical 3:4 portrait crop, performer centered and leaning diagonally forward, energetic intimate idol-show atmosphere, photorealistic DSLR quality, no readable brand logos, no added captions or watermarks.
